description.value: Yummy Yummy is a Cantonese fast-food stall located in the Parker Place food court in Richmond, BC, known for freshly handcrafted pork and beef buns, dumplings, and vermicelli soups. The open-kitchen concept lets customers watch skilled staff steam and pan-fry each item to order. It's a quick, affordable stop for touring cyclists passing through Richmond's dense multicultural food corridor along Number 3 Road.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 85m; rack at 86m; rack at 96m.

Two conflicts were found: the phone number on the Weeblyte site (+1 778 588 1113) differs from OSM (+1-604-270-8830), and the unit number on the site (#1500) differs from OSM (1238). Takeout is supported by the website's packaging reference; vegetarian/vegan/GF is mentioned on the site but flagged as unverified community content.
